about.intro: {{name}} waxay isku keentaa ururinta buugaagta iyo nolosha akhriskaaga. Ogow aragti kale, ku noqo qoraa aad jeceshahay, ama hel buug aanad ogeyn inaad u baahan tahay.
about.builtText1: Maktabaddu waxay ka bilaabataa urur, laakiin waxay nolosha ku helaa dadka akhriya. Bogganayagu wuxuu ka dhigayaa ururintaas mid fudud in la sahamiyo wuxuuna kaa caawinayaa inaad la socoto waxa aad rabto inaad akhrido.
about.builtText2: Baadh adigoon akoon lahayn. Markaad diyaar tahay, noqo xubin si aad u kaydiso cinwaannada, u dhigato kaydin, oo aad u maamusho amaahahaaga.
about.discoverText: Ka raadi cinwaan, qoraa, ama ISBN. Sahami qaybaha oo hubi nuqulada jira.
about.personalText: Hay liis akhris oo ka daawo kaydintaada akoonkaaga xubinta.
about.connectedText: Hubi taariikhaha celinta, cusboonaysii amaahaha, oo ka qaado buugaagta shaqaalaha maktabadda.
about.newText: Baro sida kaydinta, qaadashada, cusboonaysiinta iyo celinta u shaqeeyaan.

questions.question: Sidee xubin u noqdaa?
questions.answer: Fur Ku soo biir Maktabadda, buuxi foomka gaaban oo gudbi. Shaqaalaha maktabadda ayaa dib u eega codsi kasta waxaana laguu sheegi doonaa marka la ogolaado. Waxaad sidoo kale akoon isu samayn kartaa bogga Soo gal.

questions.question: Sidee buug u amaahdaa?
questions.answer: Ka hel cinwaan kaydka oo fur faahfaahintiisa. Soo gal si aad u kaydsato, kadibna la qabso shaqaalaha maktabadda qaadashada. Shaqaaluhu waxay bixiyaan nuqul gaar ah waxayna diiwaangeliyaan taariikhda celinta.

questions.question: Kaydintu ma damaanad qaadaysaa qaadasho degdeg ah?
questions.answer: Kaydintu waxay ku biirtaa safka cinwaanka. Marka nuqul banaan yahay, akhristaha ugu horreeya safka waa la ogeysiiyaa inuu diyaar yahay. Ka daawo kaydintaada albaabka xubinta.

questions.question: Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya kaydinta iyo kaydsiga?
questions.answer: Kaydintu waxay cinwaanka ku dartaa liiskaaga akhriska gaarka ah. Nuqul ma xirto. Kaydsigu wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa codsi amaah marka nuqul kuu diyaar yahay.

questions.question: Ma cusboonaysiin karaa amaah?
questions.answer: Fur Buugaagtayda albaabka xubinta oo dooro Cusboonaysii. Amaah lama cusboonaysiin karo haddii uu daahay, uu gaaray xadka cusboonaysiinta, ama uu leeyahay kaydin sugaysa.

questions.question: Sidee buug u celiyaa ama codsi u joojiyaa?
questions.answer: Nuqulada jidhka ah u celi shaqaalaha maktabadda si ay u diiwaangeliyaan celinta. Si aad kaydin u joojiso, fur Kaydinta albaabka xubinta oo dooro Jooji.

questions.question: Maxaa dhaca haddii buug daaho?
questions.answer: Amaahaha daahay waxay ka muuqdaan akoonkaaga. Fadlan ku celi buugaagta ama la hadal shaqaalaha maktabadda. Amaah cusub waa la xiraa inta aad leedahay amaaho daahay, ganaax ayaa dhici kara haddii maktabaddu dejisay.

questions.question: Xaggee ka arkaa cusboonaysiinta amaahahayga?
questions.answer: Fur Ogeysiisyada albaabka xubinta si aad u hesho cusboonaysiinta amaahda iyo kaydinta. Iimayl la xaqiijiyay, maktabaddu waxay kaloo diri kartaa xasuusin marka gaarsiinta iimaylka la furo.
